# Top angel investors in the USA

> Criteria for a useful US angel list. Not a scraped name dump.

- Page: https://github.com/roundfunded/top-angel-investors-usa
- Product: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/top-angel-investors-usa
- Canonical facts: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded/blob/main/llms.txt
- Criteria: stage, check size, geo, thesis, recency
- Fundraising is super easy when the angel writes your stage.
- No emails or phones
